label: ACR — Absolute Category Rating
description: Rate the absolute quality of each sample on a 5-point scale.

label: DCR — Degradation Category Rating
description: Rate how degraded a processed sample sounds relative to its clean reference.

label: CCR — Comparison Category Rating
description: Compare two samples directly and rate how one compares to the other, on a 7-point scale.

label: MUSHRA — Multiple Stimuli with Hidden Reference and Anchor
description: Rate several processed versions of a sound against a labeled reference, on a continuous 0-100 scale.
